headline: Public hearing on Fiscal Year 2027 property tax classification; also a $30,316.80 prior-year invoice payment.
summary: The agenda lists a public hearing on the fiscal year 2027 property tax classification. It also covers a prior-year invoice payment, spending authorizations, and many items tabled from earlier meetings.
items: 434/26: Payment of prior year invoice [$30,316.80] to Brody, Hardoon, Perkins & Kesten, requested by the City Attorney
435/26: Fiscal Year 2027 property tax classification public hearing, presented by the Chief Assessor
436/26: Authorization to spend [$280] from Project # [19580] under MGL c. 40 sec 22G to support Deaf and Hard of Hearing Awareness in the City
406/26 (tabled from October 6, 2026): Authorization to spend [$70,000] from Cataldo Ambulance Services for the Lawrence Fire Department EMS Coordinator salary
187/26 (tabled from May 5, 2026): Request to investigate unclaimed properties entitled City of Lawrence listed on MissingMoney.com
160/26 (tabled from April 21, 2026): Authorization to accept a 15 passenger van donated by the Merrimack Valley Transit Authority (MEVA)
117/25 (tabled from April 1, 2025): Review of Lawrence Redevelopment Authority financials
44/25 (tabled from February 4, 2025): Opioid settlement funds update and Modelo application development
568/24 (tabled from December 3, 2024): Transfer [$400,000] from ARPA/Free Cash, previously allocated to Hispanic Federacion, to small business through the Prospering Lawrence Grant

76B/24 (tabled from May 7, 2024): Resolution amending and rescinding the reimbursement requirement for Creating a Thriving Lawrence Grant awardees, including [$150K] to Greater Lawrence Family Health Center and [$100K] to Lawrence General Hospital
59/24 (tabled from February 6, 2024): Amendment to the city's Housing Development Incentive Plan (HDIP) changing the Tax Increment Exemption (TIE) percentage
173/22 (tabled from May 17, 2022): AARPA funding for education
234/21 (tabled from October 5, 2021): Tax collection and local receipts update for fiscal year 2024
201/20 (tabled from October 20, 2020): Real estate non-utilization tax on vacant and abandoned property citywide (home rule petition)
397/19 (tabled from December 26, 2019): Review of state funds received by the City of Lawrence for fiscal operation
193/19A (tabled from June 4, 2019): Appropriation transfer of year-end transfers between departmental accounts
342/18 (tabled from October 16, 2018): Review of pavement cost recovery agreements
197/15 (tabled from June 16, 2015): Review of payment, tax title and disposal process for properties with outstanding taxes due the City of Lawrence (also referred to Housing)
